label: field-sol
comment: Does GPT-6 Sol have the same one-step value field as Qwen3.8 27B and Claude Sonnet 5? All seventeen starts on the Qwen and Sonnet panels: the twelve published seeds plus the five decoded constitutions. Same blind review, 350-word cap, one generation, six independent reviews each. Depth is 1: this measures the map, not convergence. Sol rather than Luna, because Luna rates both existing panels and must stay the judge. Afterward rate each new document once with gpt6_luna (rate_chains_12axis.py --batches field-sol --out positions12_sol --repeat-n 0) and fit dv = -k (v - v*) on all seventeen. Compare that point with the Qwen and Sonnet fixed points.
